title: Tullius Widgets
sessionVisibilityHint: {key} temporary visibility is active. It may differ from the saved default.
autoHideResourcesNotFull: Health, magicka, or stamina below full
changeDisplaySecondsHint: Also applies to widgets set to show when values change.
freeCameraNoVitals: All resource widgets are disabled, so nothing will appear.
userFontHint: Place font folders in Data/PrismaUI/views/TulliusWidgets/user-fonts. User fonts apply to the HUD only. Settings keep the preset font. New fonts appear after restarting the game or loading a save.
userFontLoading: Loading the font “{name}”. The HUD uses the preset font until it is ready.
userFontMissing: The saved font “{name}” was not found. The HUD is using the preset font.
userFontLoadFailed: The saved font “{name}” could not be loaded. The HUD is using the preset font.
resetPositionsConfirm: Click again to reset position, size, visibility, lock and show-when for every widget
editVisibilityHint: * Hidden widgets are temporarily shown while editing.
freeCameraHint: SexLab and OStim scenes, console tfc
panelDockHint: Auto opens the window on the side that covers less of the HUD.
categoryDisplayDescription: Choose when the HUD shows and how it looks.
categoryHotkeysDescription: Keys for the settings window and for showing widgets, the language and where this window opens.
categoryProgressionDescription: Level, experience, gold, carry weight, health, magicka and stamina widgets.
categoryCombatDescription: Resistance, defense and offense stat widgets.
categoryEquipmentDescription: Equipped weapons, spells, ammo and potions, and the movement speed widget.
categoryEffectsDescription: Time and weather widgets and the timed buffs/debuffs list.
categoryLayoutDescription: Rearrange the widgets or put them back where they started.
categorySlotsDescription: Save the current arrangement, or export and import your settings as a file (hotkeys and layout slots stay out).
layoutModeHint: Drag to move; use the wheel or a corner to resize. Shift+wheel sets the background, click to fine-tune.
layoutGuideDragText: Drag a widget where you want it. Drag a corner to resize it.
layoutGuideWheelText: Over a widget, the wheel changes that widget's size. Shift+wheel changes the opacity of all widgets (the slot background on the compact HUD). Click a widget for the fine-tuning card.
layoutGuideApplyText: "Apply" keeps your changes; Esc puts positions and sizes back as they were. Opacity changed with Shift+wheel stays.
editBarMoveDownHint: Moves this bar to the bottom of the screen
editBarMoveUpHint: Moves this bar to the top of the screen
layoutModeStartHint: Folds this window away so you can move widgets anywhere on the screen.
onboardingLine3: Turn on "Auto-hide" under Display and appearance to keep the HUD hidden until combat, a drawn weapon and so on.
runtimeWarningUnsupported: Skyrim runtime is outside the supported range.
runtimeWarningAddressLibrary: Address Library file for this runtime is missing.
settingsSyncFailed: Failed to save settings. Check file path and permissions.
settingsBackupNoticeTitle: Your saved settings could not be read
settingsBackupNoticeText: This game started without your saved settings, and a change you made was saved over them, so the old settings file was kept as {file}. To go back to it, quit the game and, in the Data/SKSE/Plugins folder that holds TulliusWidgets.json, rename the current TulliusWidgets.json to something else and rename {file} to TulliusWidgets.json. With MO2 this is usually the overwrite folder; the Data tab in MO2 shows where the file really is. If the old file could not be read because it was damaged, this copy may be damaged too.
settingsBackupBanner: Your saved settings could not be read; a copy was kept. Open the settings window for details.
settingsLoadFailedText: Your saved settings could not be read, so this game started with the defaults. As long as you change nothing, the saved settings file stays as it is. If you change a setting, the old file is kept as a copy and its name appears here. The reason is in TulliusWidgets.log in the SKSE folder.
settingsLoadFailedBanner: Your saved settings could not be read; the defaults are in use. Open the settings window for details.
hudStyleHint: Switching style moves widgets to that style's default layout.
onboardingLine4: Switch the HUD style (Compact / Classic cards) under Display and appearance; Ctrl+Z undoes layout edits.
compactAnchorHint: Choosing a position or size moves every widget to that default layout (visibility is kept).
layoutSlotsHint: Save the current arrangement (style, positions, visibility) and switch back any time.
hotkeyHint: Click a button, then press the new key (click again or press Esc to cancel).
hotkeyUnsupported: Only F1–F12, Insert/Delete/Home/End/Page Up/Down, Pause/Scroll Lock and numpad keys can be used.
hotkeyInUse: That key is already used by the other hotkey.
compactSizeSmallScreenHint: Your screen is small, so text may look tiny. 'Large' is recommended.
iconThemeCompactHint: Changing the icon style moves widgets to that style's default layout (Dororong icons are larger and spaced wider).
iconPackHint: Icon packs placed in PrismaUI/views/TulliusWidgets/icon-packs show up here. Icons a pack lacks use the built-in ones.
